status: UNCONFIRMED — chunking parameters (token size, overlap) are NOT recorded in any artifact.
finding: The chunks were produced UPSTREAM by the NER/NEL prototype (a separate codebase not present in this repo). chunk_metadata records only bibliographic/structural fields (title/venue/DOI for abstracts; file/heading/page_number for textbooks), no chunking config. No chunk_size/overlap/splitter config exists anywhere in src/ or the data dir. The 256-token/50-overlap figure from the upstream §6.1.1 spec could NOT be verified and is not asserted for this corpus.
note: Empirical word counts differ markedly by source (abstracts ~3x longer than textbook chunks), which is itself inconsistent with a single fixed 256-token policy across sources.
